resources.string: A phone in a mesh only helps while it keeps running. To pass a call or live video along with the screen off, Android has to let this app keep working in the background.
The app uses more battery while a call, a live video or a relay is on. When none of them is on, it does nothing in the background.
A phone that relays for others can lose battery noticeably faster and may get warm in a pocket or bag. You can undo this at any time in Android\'s battery settings.

To keep passing calls and video along with the screen off, Android has to let this app run in the background. It uses more battery while a call, a live video or a relay is on. You can undo it in Android\'s battery settings.
